title: New Version Available
message: A newer version of Twilio Dialer is available. Update from Apps to get the latest improvements.
features: In-app New Version Available notification with Remind Me Later and Okay
Automatic what's-new list prepared from release changes
Twilio Client identity now uses id_odoo_<Account SID>
Recording, voicemail, and forward-to-device toggle improvements
Billing UI with credit packages and dialer country picker
